name: cfcmt-bus-native-actor-preference-v1
selection: All nonterminal control events along each seed-specific adapted55k native trajectory, including identical actor actions and collapsed execution intervals. No Q, action-gap, outcome, or cost selection.
execution: Only adapted actor drives every actual decision and same-time prior. Other candidates are read-only and projected onto the same frozen guard execution interval.
conditional_positive_candidate: Actual frozen actor positive_action_and_log_prob with deterministic=True, projected using the native raw state; not sampled or optimized. The positive branch uses sigmoid, not tanh.
critic_definition: Each stored twin critic scores all four projected candidates; report twin-min gaps and agreement of individual head directions.
primary_diagnosis: Frequency and sign of candidate-preference disagreements, particularly masked deterministic gate versus its own conditional-positive/zero Q ordering. Strict signed counts with reported gap distribution; no calibrated benefit threshold.
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned frozen snapshot only; no mutable Thesis access. Remote code/smallJSON/log only, no H5/CSV/checkpoint downloads.
output: Per-event compact JSONL stays on server; pull only per-seed aggregated summaries.
limits: Three training seeds share one already-used diagnostic demand/SUMO case; events are correlated and not independent performance trials.
IQL deterministic actor extraction need not maximize critic Q; disagreement alone is not an implementation error.
Discounted learned critic preferences are not true action costs. No counterfactual action is executed in this phase.
The four fixed candidates diagnose finite action preferences, not a continuous-action optimum or global critic calibration.
